glosses: etiquette (set of rules and ceremonies used in court and society)
sign, label (piece of paper, plastic or other material that is attached to an object to indicate content, price and/or other information)

examples.en: There's a label on the jar.

examples.text: Ele prendeu uma etiqueta à bolsa.
examples.en: He attached a label to the bag.

examples.text: Tom esqueceu de remover a etiqueta de preço.
examples.en: Tom forgot to remove the price tag.

examples.text: Remova as etiquetas de preço antes de embrulhar os seus presentes.
examples.en: Remove the price tags before wrapping your presents.
